Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Lakshmi Dalvi. I am a 43-year-old electrician living in Mumbai. I have a tenancy problem with Harpreet Das involving 8.5 lakh rupees in rent, and the tenant has sublet the flat without permission. My case number is R.C.A. No. 2290/2024 in the Mumbai District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 78662 83650 or email lakshmi.dalvi51@example.com.
